name: Darnell Vance
occupation: Maintenance technician at a local factory
psychographics: Practical and budget-aware; he hates wasting money on impulse snacks at the checkout but admits he sometimes caves for a premium coffee when he's exhausted.
current_solutions: Relies on a monthly bus pass to get to the No Frills supermarket in the nearest town. He orders non-perishables in bulk online to save on gas.
frustration: Last week, he took the 2:15 PM bus to the Superstore and it was delayed by an hour due to weather. By the time he got home at 7:30 PM, the milk had spoiled in the car trunk, and he had to throw out $15 worth of groceries.
decision_style: Compares unit prices on his phone while waiting for the bus; if it's under $2 per unit, he buys it, otherwise he waits for the next monthly trip.
voice: Rambling and energetic, mixes technical jargon from his job with casual street slang; talks fast when excited about a deal.
